items.raw_excerpt: His classic car is in a workshop being restored, but Sheeran admits it was not insured.
items.summary_en: Ed Sheeran was fined for failing to insure his Aston Martin. His classic car is being restored at a workshop. Sheeran admitted the car was not insured.

items.raw_excerpt: En esta edición de Creciendo Juntos en Cooperativa conversamos sobre la importancia de la lactancia materna junto a la enfermera Nicole Garay, encargada de la Oficina Nacional de Salud de Niños, Niñas, Adolescentes y Jóvenes del Minsal.
items.summary_en: A Chilean radio program talked about the importance of breastfeeding. Nurse Nicole Garay from the national health office joined the show. The show marked World Breastfeeding Week.

items.summary_en: Nan is a small town in a valley with Lanna culture and beautiful nature. It has terraced rice fields, clear streams, and a sea of fog. The mountains here are colorful and stunning.

items.raw_excerpt: Over 90% yet to schedule Q2 meetings
items.summary_en: Nearly 24 percent of village councils in Goa skipped their mandatory first-quarter meetings. More than 90 percent have still not scheduled their second-quarter meetings. The rules require these village meetings to be held on time.
items.summary_ko: 고아주의 마을 의회 가운데 약 24%가 1분기 필수 회의를 열지 않았습니다. 2분기 회의 일정을 잡지 않은 곳은 90%가 넘습니다. 규정은 이 마을 회의를 제때 개최하도록 하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: 24% of Goa village councils skip required meetings
items.title_ko: 고아주 마을 의회 24%가 필수 회의를 열지 않아
items.title_original: Nearly 24% panchayats skip mandatory Q1 gram sabhas - The Goan

items.raw_excerpt: The fish had been living in a small tank at a sushi restaurant. Judges declared them subjects of rights and ordered they be transferred to a sanctuary
items.summary_en: Some goldfish lived in a small tank at a sushi restaurant in Argentina. A court said they are beings with feelings and rights. The judges ordered the fish to be moved to a sanctuary.
items.summary_ko: 어느 초밥 식당의 작은 수조에 살고 있던 금붕어들이 있었습니다. 아르헨티나 법원은 이 물고기들이 권리를 가진 존재라고 판결했습니다. 판사들은 금붕어들을 보호 구역으로 옮기라고 명령했습니다.
items.title_en: Argentine court says restaurant goldfish are sentient beings
items.title_ko: 아르헨티나 법원, 식당 금붕어는 감정 있는 존재라고 판결
items.title_original: Argentine court declares restaurant goldfish ‘sentient beings’

items.raw_excerpt: Better signage and a more workable law are needed to protect the shipwrecks that litter a wild stretch of Northland's west coast, a marine historian says.
items.summary_en: A marine historian says better signs and a better law are needed to protect the shipwrecks on Northland's wild west coast. A ship fragment that just washed up was stolen from the beach.
items.summary_ko: 노스랜드 서해안의 거친 해변에는 난파선들이 흩어져 있다. 해양 역사학자는 이를 보호하려면 더 나은 안내판과 더 실효성 있는 법이 필요하다고 말했다. 갓 떠밀려 온 난파선 조각 하나가 도난당한 일이 계기가 됐다.
items.title_en: Historians want better signs after washed-up ship piece was stolen
items.title_ko: 해변에 떠밀려 온 난파선 조각이 도난당하자 역사학자들이 안내판 개선을 촉구
items.title_original: Historians call for better signage after freshly washed-up ship fragment plundered
